films.title: 复活男
films.synopsis: 在面试中数度落选的求职者石焕（具教焕 饰），即使正处在人生最失意的时刻，身边仍有挚友英夏（姜其永 饰）的毒舌相劝，以及妹妹艺琳（金诗雅 饰）的始终支持。然而在某天夜里，石焕突然遭到神秘陌生人袭击，当场失去性命。没想到，死亡72小时之后，他竟奇迹般地再度睁开了眼睛！石焕这才得知，自己拥有一种“无论死去多少次，都能再度复活”的特殊能力。就在他还没弄清楚究竟发生什么事时，一位神秘男子（申承浩 饰）却已经悄悄盯上了他。随着神秘男子展开步步进逼的追杀，石焕也逐渐发现，每一次的死亡，都将让自己变得更加强大。究竟，是谁想置他于死地？而这个“死得越多，变得越强”的能力，又将把他带向什么样的命运？一场赌上性命的疯狂反击，即将展开。 影片改编自同名网络漫画。
films.synopsisEn: Job seeker Seok-hwan (Koo Kyo-hwan), who has repeatedly failed at interviews, finds himself at the lowest point in life but still has his sharp-tongued best friend Young-ha (Kang Ki-young) and his ever-supportive sister Ye-rin (Kim Si-a) by his side. Then one night, Seok-hwan is suddenly attacked by a mysterious stranger and dies on the spot. Miraculously, 72 hours after his death, he opens his eyes again! Seok-hwan learns that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he can come back to life. Before he can figure out what is happening, a mysterious man (Shin Seung-ho) has already set his sights on him. As the mysterious man closes in with relentless pursuit, Seok-hwan gradually discovers that each death makes him stronger. Who wants him dead? And where will this ability — the more he dies, the stronger he becomes — lead him? A desperate fight for survival is about to begin. The film is adapted from the webtoon of the same name.

films.title: 黑牢城
films.synopsis: 天正六年，冬，“本能寺之变”四年前。 荒木村重背叛织田信长，固守在有冈城。织田军围城之下，有冈城内连续发生难以破解的棘手事件，军心动摇，人心惶惶。村重束手无策，多次向地牢中的囚犯黑田官兵卫询问破解之道。一系列事件的背后到底暗藏着什么？织田军的前军师黑田官兵卫又有何图谋？随着战事与推理逐渐展开，村重终于明白……
films.synopsisEn: In the winter of Tensho 6 (1578) — four years before Oda Nobunaga's death at Honno-ji in 1582 — Araki Murashige breaks with Nobunaga and shuts himself inside Arioka Castle. Nobunaga's army surrounds the walls. Inside, a run of unexplained crimes panics the garrison. Out of answers, Murashige keeps turning to the man in his dungeon, Kuroda Kanbei, a former Oda strategist, both for a solution and because he cannot tell what Kanbei wants. Kiyoshi Kurosawa adapted Honobu Yonezawa's novel.

films.title: 奥德赛 The Odyssey
films.synopsis: 改编自同名荷马史诗，讲述奥德修斯（马特·达蒙 饰）的故事，以及他在特洛伊战争后10年的回家之旅。
films.synopsisEn: Adapted from the Homeric epic of the same name, it tells the story of Odysseus (Matt Damon) and his 10-year journey home after the Trojan War.

films.title: 巨蟒博尤纳
films.synopsis: 一支医疗小队深入亚马逊雨林执行任务，可他们很快察觉，此地的生灵并不欢迎外来者。一行人贸然闯入，惊动了丛林掠兽 —— 博尤纳。
films.synopsisEn: A medical team ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest on a mission, but they soon realize that the creatures of this place do not welcome outsiders. Blundering in, the group awakens the jungle predator — the Boiúna.

films.title: 八仙
films.synopsis: “八仙”在成仙和成功之间选择了“成团”，在搞钱和搞事业之间选择了“搞事情”？！吕洞宾、钟离权带队，集结何仙姑、铁拐李、韩湘子、曹国舅、蓝采和与张果老，八个身份各异的凡人因不同机缘稀里糊涂凑在了蓬莱仙境，有人临时起意有人开团秒跟，开起道观过足了“神仙”瘾！面对蓬莱百姓主打一个“有求必应”，草台班子的外壳下却暗藏着“瞒天过海”的胆识。怎料一个惊天阴谋正悄咪咪朝他们砸过来，这场啼笑皆非的奇幻之旅，最终会走向何处呢？ 影片以家喻户晓的传统民间故事“八仙过海”为灵感进行创作。
films.synopsisEn: Eight mismatched mortals — Lü Dongbin, Zhongli Quan, He Xiangu, Iron Crutch Li, Han Xiangzi, Royal Uncle Cao, Lan Caihe, and Zhang Guolao — stumble into the fairy isle of Penglai and decide to live as immortals. They open a Taoist temple and tell the locals every wish will be granted, even though the whole operation is improvised. Under that cheerful scam, a conspiracy is already closing in. The comedy riffs on the folk tale of the Eight Immortals crossing the sea.

films.title: 生化危机
films.synopsis: 故事聚焦奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩（奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯 饰），意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？
films.synopsisEn: Zach Cregger directs this new Resident Evil story. Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier, is sent into Raccoon City as an outbreak overtakes the streets. What begins as one delivery becomes a night of trying to stay alive among the infected. Cregger co-wrote the script with Shay Hatten.

films.title: 世界的主人
films.synopsis: 开朗的17岁少女珠仁（徐粹彬 饰）因拒绝参与抵制性侵罪犯出狱的校园联名请愿，被迫揭开童年往事。在舆论非议中，她拒绝被标签定义，在破碎家庭、校园风波与内心阴影中完成自我和解与生命重建。一部兼具社会深度与人文温度的青春成长佳作。导演尹佳恩跳出悲情控诉和复仇叙事，以克制细腻的日常镜头呈现创伤幸存者最真实的生存状态——不渲染痛苦、不放大罪恶，只凝视这个少女如何带着伤痕继续前行。片名即宣言：伤痛无法抹去，但人生主导权始终掌握在自己手中。 本片荣获第62届百想艺术大赏电影部门最佳导演及最佳新人女演员奖。
films.synopsisEn: Joo-in (Seo Su-bin), a cheerful 17-year-old girl, is forced to confront a chapter of her childhood when she refuses to sign a school petition against the release of a sex offender. Amid public criticism, she refuses to be defined by labels and finds self-reconciliation and renewal of life as she navigates a broken family, school turmoil and inner shadows. A coming-of-age film that combines social depth with human warmth. Director Yoon Ga-eun moves beyond tragic accusation and revenge narratives, using restrained, delicate everyday camerawork to portray the most authentic state of survival for trauma survivors—neither dramatizing pain nor magnifying evil, but simply watching how this girl keeps moving forward with her scars. The title is a declaration: wounds cannot be erased, but the steering wheel of life always remains in your own hands. The film won Best Director and Best New Actress in the film category at the 62nd Baeksang Arts Awards.

films.title: 入夜不再
films.synopsis: 艾里是一名旅行灵媒，专门帮助清理游荡的灵魂，她只能在镜子倒影中看到已故妹妹的鬼魂。艾里受邀来到一处偏僻的乡间宅邸，屋里有一个面目狰狞的男鬼四处游荡。随着调查深入，艾里发现男鬼受到规则束缚并不致命，而活着的居民却隐藏着可怕的血腥秘密。
films.synopsisEn: Eri is a traveling medium who specializes in clearing out wandering spirits, and can only see the ghost of her deceased sister in mirror reflections. Eri is invited to a remote country house where a hideous male ghost roams. As her investigation deepens, Eri discovers that the male ghost is bound by rules and is not lethal—while the living residents hide a horrifying, bloody secret.

films.title: 另一个妈妈
films.synopsis: 故事讲述八岁女孩贝拉住在父母婚姻摇摇欲坠的房子里。某天，她发现衣柜深处总在深夜探出一个东西——那东西长得和她妈妈乌苏拉一模一样，于是贝拉叫它“另一个妈妈”。它每天重复同一句话：“我可以进到你心里吗？”贝拉本能地拒绝，但“另一个妈妈”开始以更扭曲狰狞的形态渗透家庭生活，甚至试图取代真正的母亲。当家中怪事频发、家人也开始看见它时，贝拉必须在被彻底吞噬前，揪出这个伪装者，或者承认有些门不该打开。 影片改编自乔什·马勒曼2024年的同名小说。
cast: 阿拉贝拉·奥利维娅·克拉克
films.synopsisEn: The story follows eight-year-old Bella, who lives in a house where her parents' marriage is falling apart. One day, she discovers something emerging from deep inside her closet late at night—something that looks exactly like her mother Ursula, so Bella calls it "Other Mommy." Every day it repeats the same question: "Can I go inside your heart?" Bella instinctively refuses, but Other Mommy begins infiltrating family life in ever more twisted and grotesque forms, even trying to replace her real mother. As strange events multiply and her family starts seeing it too, Bella must expose the impostor before being completely consumed—or admit that some doors should never be opened. The film is adapted from Josh Malerman's 2024 novel of the same name.

films.title: 青春共体 The Body +
films.synopsis: 在一次舞蹈队入会仪式出错后，一群行为不端的天主教女校学生开始出现预言性的幻象，并在她们的小镇上引发了大规模歇斯底里。
films.synopsisEn: After a dance-team initiation goes wrong, a group of misbehaving Catholic schoolgirls begin having prophetic visions, sparking mass hysteria in their small town.

films.title: 急诊室的奇迹
films.synopsis: 央大医院急诊部副主任周承俊（霍建华 饰）破格录取资质平庸的林耿明（蔡凡熙 饰），与优秀的唐希（詹子萱 饰）、江东彦（彭千祐 饰）一同担任R1住院医师。在资深主治医师何宇华（杨谨华 饰）带领下，这群新手医师随团队穿梭于高压抢救、伦理抉择与院内权力角力之间，在一次次危机中磨合成长，逐渐建立起深刻的信任与情谊。
films.synopsisEn: Zhou Chengjun (Wallace Huo), deputy director of the emergency department at Yangda Hospital, makes an exception and admits the mediocre Lin Gengming (Tsai Fan-hsi), who joins the outstanding Tang Xi (Chan Tzu-hsuan) and Jiang Dongyan (Peng Chien-yu) as R1 residents. Under senior attending physician He Yuhua (Yang Chin-hua), these rookie doctors navigate high-pressure resuscitations, ethical dilemmas and hospital power struggles, growing through each crisis and gradually building deep trust and friendship.

films.title: 冰释雪融
films.synopsis: 1992年智利。九岁的伊内丝住在祖父母经营偏远酒店，酒店位于安第斯山脉附近的滑雪胜地。她在那里结识了十五岁的德国滑雪少女汉娜，并与之建立了深厚情谊。然而，随着汉娜离奇失踪，一场调查随之展开，揭开了尘封已久的秘密。
films.synopsisEn: Chile, 1992. Nine-year-old Inés lives at a remote hotel run by her grandparents near a ski resort in the Andes. There she befriends and forms a deep bond with Hannah, a fifteen-year-old German skier. When Hannah vanishes mysteriously, an investigation unfolds, unearthing long-buried secrets.

films.title: 猛鬼乐园
films.synopsis: 少年塔克带好友闯入废弃多年的吉萨达水上乐园玩捉迷藏，同行的心智障碍好友乔德意外失踪。等乔德再度现身，已化身满心怨念的红衣恶灵，昔日好友尽数沦为猎杀目标。为求活命，一行人必须重返这座死亡乐园，在一场接一场的致命生存游戏里闯关解密，揭开水上乐园尘封多年的黑暗惨案与惊天秘密。
films.titleEn: กฤษดา พาราไดซ์
films.synopsisEn: Teenager Tak and his friends sneak into the long-abandoned Gissada water park for a game of hide-and-seek, but their companion Jod, who has an intellectual disability, mysteriously vanishes. When Jod reappears, he has become a vengeful spirit in red, and his former friends become his prey. To survive, the group must return to this park of death and fight through one deadly survival game after another, uncovering the dark massacre and shocking secrets buried there for years.

films.title: 心乡迷踪
films.synopsis: 昔日乡村音乐巨星Misty Jones（杰西卡·查斯坦 饰）重出江湖，调查她的侄女，一位冉冉升起的乡村音乐新星的失踪案。她必须面对自己的过往以及纳什维尔阴暗的地下世界。Misty的调查揭开了这座城市不为人知的黑暗面，在那里，包括她自己在内，每个人都并非表面看起来那样简单。
films.synopsisEn: Former country music superstar Misty Jones (Jessica Chastain) returns to the spotlight to investigate the disappearance of her niece, a rising country music star. She must confront her own past and Nashville's dark underworld. Misty's investigation uncovers the city's hidden darkness, where everyone—herself included—is not as simple as they seem.

films.title: 小春，屁股摇起来！
films.synopsis: 春和路易斯热爱在东京的国际标准舞舞台上竞技，但一场悲剧发生后，春把自己封闭了起来。朋友们劝说她重返舞蹈室，她却对新来的教练产生了迷恋。随着火花四溅，她必须面对接下来的一切。 导演约瑟夫·库博塔·弗拉迪卡以轻快活泼的笔触描绘了一位女性在悲痛中翩翩起舞，既温暖人心又趣味盎然。影片视觉风格大胆奔放，充满奇思妙想，却又饱含真挚的情感，鲜艳的色彩、动感的音乐和鲜活的人物形象令人眼前一亮。备受赞誉的女演员菊地凛子赋予了春这个角色深刻的细腻情感和令人喜爱的魅力，巧妙地平衡了丧夫寡妇的沉重悲痛和新生的渴望。精彩纷呈的舞蹈片段展现了她奇幻的想象世界，动感十足的编舞与同样充满活力的镜头相得益彰。虽然影片的核心是抚慰悲伤，但春的人生旅程也充满了生活的种种挑战，令人欣喜地意识到生命的美好，以及活出精彩人生的意义。
films.synopsisEn: Haru and Louis love competing on Tokyo's international ballroom dance stage, but after a tragedy, Haru shuts herself away. Friends persuade her to return to the dance studio, where she becomes infatuated with a new coach. As sparks fly, she must face whatever comes next. Director Joseph Kubota Vladika paints, with a light and lively touch, a woman dancing through grief—both heartwarming and delightful. The film's visual style is bold and exuberant, full of whimsy yet brimming with genuine emotion, with vivid colors, dynamic music and lively characters that catch the eye. Acclaimed actress Rinko Kikuchi endows Haru with profound nuance and endearing charm, deftly balancing the heavy grief of a widow with a newfound desire to live. Spectacular dance sequences reveal her fantastical inner world, with dynamic choreography matched by equally energetic camerawork. Though the film's core is solace for grief, Haru's journey is also full of life's challenges, a joyous reminder of life's beauty and the meaning of living it to the fullest.

films.title: 成为休曼
films.synopsis: 朱迪·休曼18个月时因小儿麻痹症双腿瘫痪，从小就被排斥在主流校园之外。她凭着一股不服输的韧劲，靠轮椅读完大学，却又因为坐轮椅被教育局直接拒绝发放教师执照。不甘被规则压死的她，直接起诉纽约市教育局，一路打赢官司改写规则。此后她一辈子都在推动无障碍环境和残障平权，成了美国残疾人运动史上里程碑式的人物。
films.synopsisEn: Judy Heumann was paralyzed in both legs by polio at 18 months old and was excluded from mainstream schools from an early age. With unyielding tenacity, she put herself through college in a wheelchair, only for the board of education to reject her teaching license outright because she used a wheelchair. Unwilling to be crushed by the rules, she sued the New York City Board of Education and won, rewriting the rules. For the rest of her life she championed accessibility and disability rights, becoming a landmark figure in the history of the American disability rights movement.

films.title: 老千4：别西卜之歌
films.synopsis: 靠扑克生意踩上人生巅峰的张泰英（卞约汉 饰），被最信任的同名好友朴泰英（卢在元 饰）一夜卷走全部身家，直接跌落谷底。数年后，横跨多国的巨额地下赌盘开启，昔日仇人在赌桌两端再度相遇。千术、骗术、人脉、狠命全押上桌，赌局背后还缠着黑帮势力与惊天骗局，两人在生死豪赌中互相死磕，都想把对方彻底踩进泥里。
films.synopsisEn: Jang Tae-young (Byun Yo-han), who rose to the top of the world through the poker business, has his entire fortune stolen overnight by his most trusted friend of the same name, Park Tae-young (Roh Jae-won), sending him straight to rock bottom. Years later, a massive underground gambling ring spanning multiple countries opens, and the old enemies meet again across the gambling table. Card tricks, cons, connections and ruthless all-ins are all laid on the table, with gang forces and a shocking scam tangled behind the game. In a life-or-death gamble, the two clash relentlessly, each determined to grind the other into the dirt.

films.title: 圣母玛利亚
films.synopsis: 传奇流行巨星Mother Mary（安妮·海瑟薇 饰）为了以完美形象回归舞台，找上疏远多年的好友兼前造型师萨姆（米凯拉·科尔 饰），却也掀开埋藏已久的伤疤。
cast: 帕里纳斯·埃斯梅尔萨德
films.synopsisEn: Legendary pop superstar Mother Mary (Anne Hathaway) hires her estranged friend and former stylist Sam (Michaela Coel) to help her return to the stage in perfect form, only to reopen long-buried wounds.

films.title: 懂事之年 철들 무렵
films.synopsis: 曾凭借处女作《移墓》引发关注 —— 这部作品兼具忧郁与幽默气质 —— 的导演郑胜吾，携第二部长片回归。影片围绕三位角色展开：被诊断出癌症晚期的父亲哲泽、既承担工作又肩负照料职责的女儿贞美，以及渴望挣脱家庭角色、追寻自由的贤淑，并再次将一个大家庭的故事搬上银幕。 影片塑造独特韵味的叙事手法愈发成熟厚重。它以温柔的笔触包容人际关系的复杂，同时又通过日常生活中充满讽刺与机智的片段，不时为故事增添一抹犀利的质感。《懂事之年》并未将 “家庭” 这一概念束缚在单一叙事中，而是在其中融入了时代的印记、代际的隔阂与个体的欲望。 影片在串联众多角色与故事线方面的能力尤为突出，其以包容视角解读疾病、衰老、照料与扶持等现实议题的态度也同样亮眼。透过每个角色的人生经历，影片传递出一种令人安心的坚实感。
films.synopsisEn: Director Jung Seung-oh, who drew attention with his debut feature "Mudem" — a work blending melancholy and humor — returns with his second feature. The film revolves around three characters: Cheol-taek, a father diagnosed with terminal cancer; Jeong-mi, a daughter who shoulders both work and caregiving duties; and Hyeon-suk, who longs to break free from her family role and pursue freedom — once again bringing a large family's story to the screen. The distinctive narrative approach that gives the film its unique flavor has grown more mature and substantial. It embraces the complexity of human relationships with a gentle touch, while occasionally adding a sharp edge to the story through ironic and witty episodes from everyday life. "The Year of Maturity" does not confine the concept of "family" to a single narrative, but weaves into it the marks of the times, generational divides, and individual desires. The film stands out particularly in its ability to connect numerous characters and storylines, and its inclusive perspective on such real-world issues as illness, aging, caregiving, and mutual support is equally impressive. Through each character's life experience, the film conveys a reassuring sense of solidity.

films.title: 人为何要写情书
films.synopsis: 影片以2000年3月发生的营团地铁日比谷线中目黑站脱轨相撞事故为背景。事故中遇难的其中一人是少年富久信介。常与他搭乘同一班通勤电车的少女对少年萌生了爱慕之情。但事故突然发生。20年后，一封陌生来信寄到了信介曾训练的大桥拳击馆会长大桥秀行手中。
films.synopsisEn: The film is set against the March 2000 derailment and collision at Nakameguro Station on the Eidan Subway Hibiya Line. One of those who died in the accident was a boy named Tomihisa Shinsuke. A girl who often rode the same commuter train as him developed feelings for the boy. But the accident struck suddenly. Twenty years later, a letter from a stranger arrives at the hands of Ohashi Hideyuki, chairman of the Ohashi Boxing Gym where Shinsuke once trained.

films.title: 向往的冒险 Das geträumte Abenteuer :
films.synopsis: 考古学家来到保加利亚边境小镇工作，偶遇多年未见的故人后，逐步卷入藏于平静表面下的犯罪网络，自己的幽微过往也随之浮现…… 这是一场以考古为喻的地域探查，写实观察混入犯罪悬疑，拆开英雄假象，重见女性存在。细腻拿捏一举拿下戛纳电影节评审团奖。
films.synopsisEn: An archaeologist arrives to work in a small border town in Bulgaria and, after a chance encounter with someone she hasn't seen in years, gradually becomes entangled in a criminal network lurking beneath the placid surface—while her own shadowy past resurfaces... This is a regional excavation that uses archaeology as metaphor, blending realistic observation with crime suspense to strip away the illusion of heroism and restore the presence of women. Its delicate handling won the Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival.

films.title: 裸金
films.synopsisEn: Nacktgeld (2025) Director: Thomas Imbach Screenwriter: Thomas Imbach Starring: Katharina Schüttler / Milan Peschel / Deleila Piasko / Jan Bülow / Claudia Hübschmann Genre: Drama Production Country/Region: Switzerland

films.title: 瓦利斯岛的歌谣
films.synopsis: 性格孤僻却热爱音乐的彩票中奖者查尔斯（提姆·科伊 饰），独自生活在偏远的瓦利斯岛上。多年来，他始终希望最喜爱的双人音乐组合兼昔日恋人麦圭尔（汤姆·巴斯登 饰）与莫蒂默（凯瑞·穆里根 饰）能够再次同台。当梦想中的两人接受邀请，来到岛上进行一场私人演出时，查尔斯终于等来了梦寐以求的时刻。然而，随着尘封已久的情感与矛盾重新浮现，这场看似完美的重聚逐渐失去控制。为了守住自己精心筹备的一切，查尔斯不得不想办法让这场演出继续下去。
films.synopsisEn: Charles (Tim Key), an eccentric lottery winner who loves music, lives alone on the remote island of Wallis. For years he has hoped that his favorite duo—and former lover—McGuire (Tom Basden) and Mortimer (Carey Mulligan) would perform together again. When the pair accept his invitation to come to the island for a private concert, Charles finally gets the moment he has dreamed of. But as long-buried feelings and conflicts resurface, the seemingly perfect reunion gradually spins out of control. To protect everything he has carefully arranged, Charles must find a way to keep the show going.

films.title: 警督巴比塔・辛格 बबीता सिंह रिपोर्टिंग 印度
films.synopsis: 故事发生在印度一座小镇。被停职的女警官巴比塔（昵称贝比），一生总在迁就他人、优先顾及别人的感受。童年好友惨遭谋杀，巨大悲痛驱使她执意追查凶案真相，这场调查也意外开启了她的自我找寻之旅。以一桩谋杀案调查为叙事外壳，影片落地现实质感，刻画复杂家庭关系，讲述一名女性直面人生抉择、重新夺回自我话语权的故事。
films.synopsisEn: The story takes place in a small town in India. Babita (nicknamed Baby), a suspended female police officer, has spent her life accommodating others and putting their feelings first. When her childhood friend is brutally murdered, her grief drives her to pursue the truth of the case, and the investigation unexpectedly sets her on a journey of self-discovery. Using a murder investigation as its narrative shell, the film grounds itself in realism, portraying complex family relationships and telling the story of a woman who confronts life's choices and reclaims her own voice.

films.title: 多萝西娅
films.synopsis: 美国80年代，看似慈祥的“奶奶”多萝西娅·普恩特，以寄宿公寓为诱饵，下药、杀害、掩埋数十位弱势老年与残疾租客，将花园变成埋尸地。狱中濒死的她，回溯自己从受虐者到连环杀手的黑暗一生，用温柔表象包裹极致贪婪与残忍。
films.synopsisEn: In 1980s America, the seemingly kindly "grandmother" Dorothea Puente lured dozens of vulnerable elderly and disabled tenants to her boarding house, where she drugged, killed, and buried them, turning her garden into a burial ground. Near death in prison, she looks back on her dark life from abuse victim to serial killer, wrapping extreme greed and cruelty in a gentle facade.

films.title: 总统的蛋糕 مملكة القصب
films.synopsis: 人人都中头奖，难道人人都想中头奖？九十年代伊拉克经历军事及经济制裁，独裁者萨达姆无惧动乱，勒令全国为自己庆祝生日。九岁女孩「喜获头奖」成为学校代表，被迫接下为总统炮制生日蛋糕的国家级重任。然而通货膨胀、物资匮乏，鸡蛋面粉都是奢侈品，女孩带着宠物公鸡，从沼泽向城市出发搜罗食材，完成这项国家交给她的任务！首有伊拉克电影进军戛纳，编导借小女孩充满稚气却坚韧的目光，展现伊拉克从未被记录过的一面，献给在战乱下仍能找到爱与友谊的小孩。戛纳电影节金摄像机最佳首作。
cast: 巴尼恩·艾哈迈德·纳耶夫
瓦希德·萨比特·赫雷巴特
萨贾德·穆罕默德·卡西姆
films.synopsisEn: Does everyone who wins the jackpot actually want it? In 1990s Iraq, under military and economic sanctions, dictator Saddam Hussein defies the turmoil and orders the entire nation to celebrate his birthday. A nine-year-old girl "wins the jackpot" by being chosen as her school's representative, forced to take on the national mission of baking the president's birthday cake. But with hyperinflation and scarce supplies, eggs and flour are luxuries — so the girl sets off with her pet rooster from the marshes to the city to gather ingredients and complete the task her country has given her. The first Iraqi film to be selected for Cannes, its writer-director uses the girl's childish yet resilient gaze to reveal a side of Iraq never before captured on film — a tribute to children who can still find love and friendship amid war. Winner of the Caméra d'Or for Best First Feature at the Cannes Film Festival.

films.title: 马登
films.synopsis: 基于真实故事，讲述脾气火爆的前NFL主教练约翰·马登在奥克兰突袭者队被迫退役后，与温文尔雅的哈佛程序员、艺电公司创始人特里普·霍金斯合作，通过打造世界上第一个橄榄球视频游戏来改写他日渐式微的资产。随后他步入体育解说界，为ABC、CBS、FOX、NBC等播出的橄榄球比赛担任解说员，延续传奇职业生涯。
films.synopsisEn: Based on a true story, it follows hot-tempered former NFL head coach John Madden who, after being forced into retirement from the Oakland Raiders, teams up with mild-mannered Harvard programmer and Electronic Arts founder Trip Hawkins to rewrite his fading fortunes by creating the world's first football video game. He then moves into sports commentary, calling football games for ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC and others, extending his legendary career.

films.title: 挽救计划（2026）
films.synopsis: 太阳正在被“吃”掉，绝望吞噬地球。一名“平凡”的中学教师格雷斯（瑞恩·高斯林 饰）背负全人类的希望，踏上“太空不归路”。末路孤旅中，他意外遇到一位外星萌友，一个同样身陷绝境的外星工程师，这对“宇宙搭子”成了两个文明最后的救命稻草。他们能否在资源紧缺的情况下攻克重重科学谜 题，寻回唯一的希望火种？ 影片改编自安迪·威尔的同名畅销科幻小说。
cast: 巴斯蒂安·安东尼奥·富恩特斯
films.synopsisEn: The sun is being "eaten," and despair devours the Earth. An "ordinary" middle school teacher, Grace (Ryan Gosling), carries the hopes of all humanity and embarks on a one-way journey into space. On this lonely final voyage, he unexpectedly meets an alien companion — an alien engineer also stranded in a desperate situation — and this "cosmic duo" becomes the last lifeline for two civilizations. Can they overcome countless scientific mysteries despite scarce resources and recover the sole spark of hope? The film is adapted from Andy Weir's bestselling sci-fi novel of the same name.

films.title: 天才谋杀法
films.synopsis: 爱德华打断了海史密斯在瑞士阿尔卑斯山孤独的晚年生活。爱德华是一位年轻的文学经纪人，受出版公司的委托，说服她为人气很高的雷普利系列（其中包括经典的《天才雷普利》）写最后一部小说。海史密斯用她出名的恐怖想象力把爱德华吓跑了，不过在他们意识到之前，一场合作已经开始了，这让两人难以区分他们构建的世界和他们生活的世界。
cast: 马达莱娜·瓦莱基·威廉姆斯
films.synopsisEn: Edward interrupts Highsmith's solitary late years in the Swiss Alps. Edward is a young literary agent tasked by a publishing house with persuading her to write one final novel for the popular Ripley series (which includes the classic The Talented Mr. Ripley). Highsmith scares Edward off with her famously macabre imagination, but before they know it, a collaboration has begun, making it hard for the two to distinguish between the worlds they construct and the worlds they inhabit.

films.title: 悲伤女孩
films.synopsis: 宝拉和拉玛埃斯特拉是十六岁的墨西哥少女，既是挚友，也是各自游泳队里势均力敌的对手。然而，当宝拉在派对上遭遇强奸后，体育竞争便退居次席。得知袭击事件的拉玛埃斯特拉决意用自己的方式为朋友复仇，事态却急转直下。
films.synopsisEn: Paula and Rama Estela are sixteen-year-old Mexican girls who are both best friends and evenly matched rivals on their respective swim teams. But when Paula is raped at a party, athletic competition takes a back seat. Upon learning of the assault, Rama Estela resolves to take revenge on her friend's behalf in her own way — yet events spiral quickly out of control.

films.title: 蚊子帮的夏天
films.synopsis: 1997年，八岁的琳达和无忧无虑的母亲伊娃离开了富裕祖母位于瑞士的别墅。在意大利，她结识了阿祖拉和玛尔塔。一个夏天的情谊将三个女孩紧紧联系在一起，她们组成了一个小团体，互相守护彼此、守护她们的青春和自由。然而，在她们周围，却充斥着追逐脆弱梦想的自私父母、爱嚼舌根的邻居，以及一位在恐同世界中苦苦寻找归属感的同性恋保姆。
cast: 杰西卡·皮科罗·瓦莱拉尼
films.synopsisEn: In 1997, eight-year-old Linda and her carefree mother Eva leave her wealthy grandmother's villa in Switzerland. In Italy, she meets Azzurra and Marta. A summer bond ties the three girls closely together, forming a little gang that protects one another, their youth and their freedom. Around them, however, swirl self-absorbed parents chasing fragile dreams, gossipy neighbors, and a gay nanny struggling to find belonging in a homophobic world.

films.title: 完美说谎者
films.synopsis: 欢迎来到塔霍城，权力、特权和致命的秘密隐藏在完美的外表之下。裘德·德里来到这所贵族大学，肩负着一项隐藏的使命：渗透进卡什兄弟的圈子，揭开她哥哥死亡的真相。家族帝国的三个继承人——魅力非凡、精于算计的长子埃根、神秘莫测的二哥阿德里克和叛逆不可捉摸的小儿子亚历山德雷——以无人能抗拒的魅力主宰着塔霍城。当裘德卷入卡什家族复杂的家庭关系时，个人复仇的阴谋演变成了危险的诱惑、禁忌的吸引和谎言的三角关系。随着她发现的每一个线索，她都更接近真相，而这个真相不仅可能摧毁这个强大的家族……也可能揭示她自己或许还没有准备好面对的秘密。
films.synopsisEn: Welcome to Tahoe City, where power, privilege and deadly secrets hide beneath a flawless facade. Jude Derry arrives at this elite university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the Cash brothers' circle and uncover the truth behind her brother's death. The three heirs to the family empire — the charismatic and calculating eldest, Egan, the enigmatic middle brother, Adric, and the rebellious, unpredictable youngest, Alexandre — rule Tahoe City with an irresistible charm. As Jude is drawn into the tangled dynamics of the Cash family, her personal vendetta turns into a dangerous triangle of temptation, forbidden attraction and lies. With every clue she uncovers, she draws closer to a truth that could destroy this powerful family... or reveal secrets about herself she may not be ready to face.

films.title: 仲夏惊魂夜
films.synopsis: 故事发生在盛夏“夏日万圣节”的狂欢夜晚，独居女主搬进城郊一栋老式独栋住宅，本打算趁着特色节日放松独处时光。一名妆容破败、面部带有撕裂伤痕的变态小丑杀手盯上了这栋偏僻屋子......
films.synopsisEn: Summerween 2026, official Chinese-English subtitles, latest release. The story takes place on a midsummer "Summer Halloween" night of revelry, when a woman living alone moves into an old detached house on the outskirts of the city, planning to enjoy some solitary time during the distinctive holiday. A deranged clown killer with ruined makeup and torn, scarred features sets his sights on the isolated house...

films.title: 我的妻子哭了 Meine Frau weint
films.synopsis: 一名男子得知妻子长期拥有一位情人，而这位情人如今已在意外中离世。两人的婚姻濒临破碎。在城郊一栋僻静的空置平房里，他们试图通过对话向彼此敞开心扉。
films.synopsisEn: A man learns that his wife has long had a lover, who has now died in an accident. Their marriage is on the brink of collapse. In a quiet, empty bungalow on the outskirts of town, they try to open up to each other through conversation.

films.title: 童话继姐妹 Steps
films.synopsis: 聚焦灰姑娘那“不那么邪恶”的继姐妹，Lilith和Margot将被呈现为善良的形象，她们只是一直被误解。 在皇家舞会上，Lilith不慎用一根偷来的魔杖把Margot变成了一只青蛙，并让王国落到了一个疯狂迷恋王子的小气女孩手中。现在Lilith必须与Cinderella组队，一起拯救王国，修正已四分五裂的童话故事，并证明所谓的反派也值得一个HE结局的机会。
films.synopsisEn: Focusing on Cinderella's "not-so-evil" stepsisters, Lilith and Margot are portrayed as kind figures who have simply been misunderstood all along. At the royal ball, Lilith accidentally turns Margot into a frog with a stolen wand and delivers the kingdom into the hands of a petty girl hopelessly infatuated with the prince. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella to save the kingdom, mend the fractured fairy tale, and prove that so-called villains deserve their chance at a happy ending too.

films.title: 坏兽
films.synopsis: 以寄宿学校女孩雅典娜为中心，她得到进入新家庭的机会，却因害怕被替代而逐渐显露危险本能。
films.synopsisEn: Centering on Athena, a girl at a boarding school who gets the chance to join a new family, but whose fear of being replaced gradually brings out a dangerous instinct.

films.title: 茫然女王
films.synopsis: 阿尔茨海默病逐渐剥夺了一位女性表达自我的能力，也严重影响了她与他人的沟通。她的丈夫与女儿竭力为她谋求最大福祉——在爱与关怀、守护与自主之间的脆弱边界中艰难探寻平衡。
films.synopsisEn: Alzheimer's gradually strips a woman of her ability to express herself, severely affecting her communication with others. Her husband and daughter strive to secure her greatest wellbeing—navigating the fragile balance between love and care, protection and autonomy.

films.title: 街头霸王 Street Fighter
films.synopsis: 故事设定在1993年，昔日并肩作战却早已分道扬镳的街头格斗家隆（安德鲁·浩二 饰）与肯·马斯特斯（诺亚·琴蒂内奥 饰），因为受到一名神秘女子春丽（卡莉娜·梁 饰）的招募，再度参加下一届世界战士格斗大会，这是一场拳头、命运与怒火碰撞的残酷对决。但是在这场生死大决斗的背后，潜藏着一个致命阴谋，迫使他们不得不正面交锋，并且面对各自过去的心魔。如果他们无法克服这一切，那就会GAME OVER游戏结束！
films.synopsisEn: Set in 1993, former allies turned rivals Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are recruited by a mysterious woman, Chun-Li (Callina Liang), to compete in the next World Warrior Tournament—a brutal showdown where fists, fate, and fury collide. But behind this fight to the death lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off and confront the demons of their pasts. If they can't overcome it all, it's GAME OVER!

films.title: 忘却之岛 Forgotten Island
films.synopsis: 当记忆开始消失，友谊还能留下什么？两位挚友意外来到充满神奇生物的“忘却之岛”，等待她们的却是未知的风险——在这里，记忆会被一点点剥夺，曾经最珍贵的回忆也可能被彻底遗忘。面对未知的危险和不断流逝的过往，她们不得不与时间赛跑，在守护彼此友谊的同时寻找回家的方向。这个关于陪伴、勇气与成长，带有浓郁的菲律宾神话背景的故事，将带领观众踏上一段温暖而动人的奇幻旅程。
films.synopsisEn: When memories begin to fade, what remains of friendship? Two best friends unexpectedly arrive on the "Forgotten Island," a place full of magical creatures, only to face unknown dangers—here, memories are stripped away bit by bit, and even the most precious recollections may be lost forever. Facing unforeseen peril and their slipping past, they must race against time, protecting their friendship while searching for a way home. This story of companionship, courage, and growth, steeped in rich Filipino mythology, takes audiences on a warm and moving fantasy journey.

films.title: 摩托GP大电影：极速传承 Ídolos
films.synopsis: 鲁莽的天才摩托手埃杜·塞拉获得Aspar Moto2车队的参赛机会，却必须接受疏离多年的父亲——曾因事故退役的前冠军车手安东尼奥·贝拉尔迪的训练。在竞速梦想、父子旧怨与意外爱情的三重拉扯中，他踏上自我蜕变与和解的赛道。
films.synopsisEn: Reckless genius motorcyclist Edu Serra gets a chance to race for the Aspar Moto2 team, but must first be trained by his estranged father Antonio Belardi, a former champion forced to retire after an accident. Pulled between his racing dream, old father-son grievances and an unexpected romance, he sets out on a track of self-transformation and reconciliation.

films.title: 替子道歉 Vicentina Pede Desculpas
films.synopsis: 当她的儿子驾驶的公交车从立交桥上坠落，导致数十人丧生后，维森蒂娜找到遇难者家属道歉，却发现了宽恕的极限。
films.synopsisEn: After her son crashes a bus off a highway overpass, killing dozens, Vicentina seeks out the victims' families to apologize—and discovers the limits of forgiveness.

films.title: 多萝西 Dorothy
films.synopsis: 故事背景设定在一个由种姓制度、暴力和有毒男性气质所塑造的世界中，两个童年好友在泰米尔纳德邦的乡村形影不离地长大。一位名叫多萝西的女性的到来改变了他们的生活，她的同情心悄然挑战了他们周围的世界。
films.synopsisEn: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. The arrival of a woman named Dorothy changes their lives, her compassion quietly challenging the world around them.

films.title: 异梦 Dreams
films.synopsis: Fernando是一位来自墨西哥的年轻芭蕾舞演员，他梦想着在美国获得国际声誉和生活。他相信他的恋人Jennifer（一位社交名媛和慈善家）会支持他，于是他抛弃了一切，在穿越边境时险些丧命。然而，他的到来打乱了Jennifer精心打造的世界。她愿意做任何事情来保护他们共同的未来—以及她为自己建立的生活。

films.title: 蚊子杯：最后一役
films.synopsis: 二战中偷袭珍珠港时期，四个美国顶级大学生橄榄球员此前放弃名利加入了海军陆战队，在准备迎接日军袭击时，他们打了一场传奇性的橄榄球比赛，有一些历史上最好的球员加入。而这场赛事对很多人来说，将是他们人生的最后一场比赛。
